decisions.statement: Every file that moves is answered as one move.
A carry handing in no path is refused.
A path with no body, or landing where a body already sits, refuses the carry.
A path landing where it already sits refuses the carry.
Whether a carry is refused is one question here rather than one in each caller.
The importers of everything that moved are asked of the index in one call.
A body is repointed over one map of what moved rather than one map for each file.
A body that moved is repointed at the path that body landed at.
A whole carry answers the moves, then the repointing.

definition: the edits carrying many files to new paths and following them everywhere named
